page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Top: a Hebrew line centred. Then centred title lines in capitals and small capitals. Below: a woodcut engraving of a sun within an ornamental frame with figures. Lower down: an imprint line with a date below a rule. No margins with text.
page.notes: Woodcut engraving in the centre: a sun with a face within a circular frame, flanked by two figures and floral and architectural ornament; no text in it. The Hebrew line is printed above the title and is transcribed as read; its letters are only partly legible at this scan, so the reading מלחמות ה׳ is uncertain. The "De" line carries a swash-style D and e.
